subject: g09 genecp in QM/MM MD in amber

messages.author: Vaibhav Dixit
messages.body:
Dear All,
I saw an old question <
http://archive.ambermd.org/201307/0764.html
> related
to using pseudopotentials during QM/MM-MD in Amber.
Thus I'm curious to know if this is possible in Amber19 now. I can't find
an obvious answer from the manual section 10.2 and 10.2.6.3. The
sub-section on the basis option doesn't mention ecp/pseudopotentials.
Will it work if I give the full information (coefficients) as given by
GFPrint/GFInput keywords in g09? considering the complexity of the system
setup, I wanted to understand the capabilities before spending 5-10 days on
preparing the inputs.
Looking forward to getting valuable suggestions and hints from the list.
Thank you and best regards
Vaibhav
-- 
Regards,
Dr. Vaibhav A. Dixit,

University of Manchester, 131 Princess Street, Manchester M1 7DN, UK.
